story_text:
## Meet TACO AI
TACO AI is a handheld remote and companion software designed to replace your mouse and keyboard in everyday work. Taco Remote puts navigation in your hand, with a touch panel and physical controls. Taco Hub turns your voice into text, so you can speak instead of typing.
With computer use, Taco Hub can act on your computer for you: opening apps, searching for information, sending emails, and more.
Speak a rough thought or an AI prompt, and it comes out as clear text, without filler words or repetition. Taco Hub even picks up a whisper, so you won’t disturb anyone nearby.
## Key Features
Keep your creative flow moving.
Move between tasks while TACO AI creates assets that better match your ideas.
Keep meetings and tasks on track.
Use TACO AI to organize meeting notes and manage tasks, even when you’re away from your computer.
Work without constantly reaching for your keyboard.
Dictate text and give TACO AI voice commands, so you can write and chat comfortably from your chair.
## Computer Use
Need to find information, open an app, or send an email? Tell TACO AI what you need. It can carry out those tasks on your computer, while TACO AI keeps mouse-like navigation and physical controls close at hand. Lights and vibration keep you in the loop as TACO AI works, finishes, or needs your attention.
Use the touch panel to scroll through documents and conversations, or switch between apps you already have open. You can also map virtual keys to the operations you use most often.
Press the voice button to start dictating, and your words appear in the active input field in real time. Use voice input for emails, notes, documents, messages, and AI prompts. For longer passages or detailed instructions, speaking can help you create a first draft faster.
## Speak Naturally, Taco Polish
The point of voice is not simply capturing every word. It is to let you keep thinking while your words become useful. Speak with pauses. Correct yourself halfway through. Change direction mid-sentence.
Personal Style and Context Adaptation
It can remove filler words and repetition, handle mid-sentence corrections, and turn rough speech into clear writing or more precise AI prompts. It can also adapt tone and formatting to the context, helping a message feel right for a quick team update, a formal email, a note, or a prompt.
In Every App, on Every Device
TACO supports Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android. Connect to multiple devices at once, then switch between your phone, computer, laptop, tablet, and even Xbox with a single button.
## In Every App, on Every Device
Keep the dictation apps you already use. TACO Remote works with apps like Wispr Flow and Typeless, so you can keep your preferred voice-to-text workflow while controlling your computer from one handheld device.
See Progress without Staying at Your Desk
You don’t have to keep staring at your screen or stay at your desk. Lights and vibration let you know whether an Agent is still working, has finished, or has run into an error.
## See When it is Done
## One-handed Control
Its compact circular form, touch panel, physical controls, and voice input work together so you can speak, scroll, switch, and confirm without changing your posture or reaching for a full keyboard and mouse setup.
Use it while sitting at a desk, standing in a meeting, reviewing work on a laptop, or moving between devices.
With a built-in microphone array and hardware and software noise reduction, TACO is tuned to pick up close-range, low-volume speech while suppressing background noise.
Whether you whisper in a quiet room or speak in a noisy subway, TACO is designed to accurately capture every word. In test conditions, speech recognition accuracy reaches up to 98.7%.
## Stay Local, Stay Vocal
Wireless charging makes it simple to top up TACO: simply place it on a wireless charger. A full charge provides approximately 12 hours of standby time, and a full recharge takes about 1.5–2 hours.

Our development process includes staged testing and validation to support reliable everyday use and prepare for production. We’ve secured reliable suppliers to support hardware production, with real-world testing helping us refine Taco’s look and feel. These measures help reduce delivery risks, though enclosure refinement and certification still carry a risk of delays. Taco has already been tested on major platforms. We’re extending compatibility testing to more computers, operating systems, and apps, with software updates to improve performance across these environments. Any known limitations or additional setup requirements will be clearly communicated. Even with these measures in place, unexpected delays during production, certification, or shipping remain possible. If our timeline or planned features change, we’ll explain what changed, what it means for backers, and the steps we’re taking to address it.

faq.q: Why use Taco if I already have a microphone and dictation software?
faq.a:
We designed Taco so you can work more comfortably and efficiently, without constantly reaching for your mouse and keyboard. Voice input, voice command, customizable buttons, and on-screen controls let you handle many everyday tasks from a handheld remote.

Holding Taco also lets you bring its built-in microphone closer to your mouth, helping it capture clearer speech for more accurate recognition and reduce interference from surrounding noise. In quiet spaces, you can speak more softly instead o…

faq.q: Do I need to install Taco Hub, your companion app, to use Taco Remote?
faq.a:
Yes. Taco Hub is required to connect your Taco Remote to your computer or phone and configure its physical buttons and on-screen controls.

Taco Hub also includes a free usage allowance for dictation and agentic commands. If you already use another dictation or AI agent app, you can turn off these built-in features in Taco Hub and map Taco’s controls to your preferred app’s keyboard shortcuts.

Taco then works as a dedicated microphone and remote for those apps, while Taco Hub handles the connec…

faq.q: Do I need a subscription to use Taco?
faq.a:
No. A subscription is optional. You can use Taco as a remote through Taco Hub—including its physical buttons, on-screen controls, and shortcut mappings—without a Taco subscription. You can also use it with your existing dictation or AI agent apps.

Taco Hub includes a free usage allowance for its built-in dictation and agentic commands. Online features use AI model APIs, which incur usage costs, so heavier users may need a paid plan for additional usage.

Every Taco Remote purchase includes one…

faq.q: Is your companion app, Taco Hub, free to use? What’s the difference between the free and paid plans?
faq.a:
Yes. Taco Hub is free to use.

Taco Hub offers an ongoing free plan with no credit card required. Each week, it includes:
- 2,500 words of dictation
- 2 hours of meeting recording and AI summaries
- A limited allowance of agentic command credits

For unlimited dictation, expanded access to meeting recording and AI notes, and more agentic command credits, you can upgrade to Taco Pro.

No Taco subscription is required to use Taco Remote’s connection, button mapping, or remote control features thro…

faq.q: Can I use Taco offline or with my own local AI models?
faq.a:
Yes, depending on the feature. Taco Hub supports offline dictation & text clean up.

You can also use Taco as a handheld microphone and remote controller for your own local AI setup. Speak into Taco’s built-in microphone to provide voice input, and use Taco Hub to map its physical buttons or on-screen controls to shortcuts in your preferred apps or workflows. Whether your setup works fully offline depends on the software and models you use.

Taco Hub is still required to manage the remote’s conn…

We expect to begin shipping in JAN 2027.
We’ll keep backers updated throughout production and fulfillment.

faq.q: When/How do I provide shipping details?
faq.a: After the Kickstarter campaign ends and is successfully funded, we will send you a link to our Pledge Manager. There, you will be able to confirm your reward, add any available extras, pay for shipping, and provide your shipping address. Kickstarter does not collect or store your shipping information at checkout.

Taco Hub supports iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows. We’ve tested compatibility with commonly used OS versions, though older versions may have compatibility limitations.

You can switch between paired Bluetooth devices with a single tap on Taco Remote’s display, making it easy to work across multiple computers and other devices throughout the day.

faq.q: Are the same features available on desktop and mobile?
faq.a:
Dictation is available on all four platforms. You can use Taco for voice typing on your computer or phone.

Agentic commands are currently available only on macOS and Windows. On iOS and Android, Taco supports voice typing but cannot control your phone through voice commands.

faq.q: How do I pair Taco Remote to my computer or phone?
faq.a:
On Mac or Windows: Download and open Taco Hub, then connect Taco Remote with a USB-C cable (included in the box) to complete the initial Bluetooth pairing. After setup, Taco connects over Bluetooth—no cable or separate USB wireless receiver is needed.

On iOS or Android: Download the Taco Hub app and scan the QR code on your Taco Remote to pair over Bluetooth.

After the initial setup, Taco automatically reconnects when Bluetooth is enabled and the paired device is available. To add another comp…

faq.q: How does Taco protect my voice and text data?
faq.a:
Taco Hub lets you choose between local and online models for supported features.

When using offline dictation, your voice and transcription are processed locally on your device, without being uploaded to cloud AI services.

When you choose online processing, the audio and/or text needed for that feature is sent to the relevant AI service. Taco Hub’s built-in agentic commands currently require online processing.

faq.q: Which languages does Taco support, and can it translate?
faq.a:
Taco supports over 100 languages, multilingual dictation, and translation between supported languages. It can also recognize when you mix languages within the same sentence.

In translation mode, simply choose your target language and speak—Taco translates your speech into text in that language.

faq.q: Which apps and software can I use with Taco?
faq.a:
Taco’s dictation works in most text fields across desktop apps and websites—from emails and messages to documents, code editors, and AI chats. Examples include Gmail, Slack, iMessage, Notion, ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor.

Once Taco Hub is set up, dictation generally requires no additional integration with each app. You can also map Taco’s buttons and on-screen controls to keyboard shortcuts in your preferred software.

Agentic commands and notifications depend on the app and the integrations ava…

faq.q: How does Taco’s notification feature work?
faq.a:
Taco can notify you when a supported AI agent, such as Claude or Codex, finishes a task or needs your approval. Those notifications will be sent to your Taco remote to you, so you can review it without constantly checking your computer.

Built-in RGB lights and haptic feedback alert you when something needs your attention, helping you stay informed while you focus on other work.
